adjudicated_statement: Work over C with Q-coefficients in the FND-0167 setup for (g,n)=(6,6). Let S be a reduced separated finite-type C-scheme of pure dimension 15 carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) genus-six degree-four family whose relative degree-six line bundle L is fibrewise base-point-free with h^0=3, so that formation of pi_*L commutes with base change. Put A=P_S(pi_*L), a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle of dimension 17; let Delta be the non-reduced-divisor locus; put U=A minus Delta; and let Z=Ord(U)->U be the finite etale right S_6-torsor of orderings. FND-0167 supplies an injection of pure polarizable weight-16 Hodge structures Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q)^{S_6}=Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U;Q) into Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) direct-sum Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S;Q)(-1) direct-sum Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S;Q)(-2), obtained by composing the FND-0165 corner injection for the open immersion U subset A with the projective-bundle formula for A->S. Polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of a fixed weight form a semisimple abelian category, so this injection propagates Tate type of Q(-8) from the three constant-coefficient S-corners (H-S) down to U and to the S_6-invariants of T_16(Z). It cannot propagate non-Tate type from S to U or to Z: a non-Tate ambient Hodge structure may contain a Tate subobject, and FND-0167 does not assert surjectivity of the corner map. Independently, fibrewise Bertini (the general member of |L| consists of six distinct points) together with the classical discriminant and dual-curve description of a spanned g^2_6 in |L| isomorphic to P^2 imply that Delta->S is nonempty of pure relative dimension one, hence dim Delta=16. Deligne's Hodge-number bound (h^{p,q}=0 for p greater than the dimension) therefore does not force F^{15} H_c^{16}(Delta;C)=0, so the type-(15,1) lifting argument used by ATT-0118, which requires the removed locus to have dimension at most 14, does not lift classes from A to U. Consequently ATT-0118's refutation of (H-S) at j=8 on an allowed atlas component does not refute Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U;Q) or Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q), both of which remain open. A repair of C66-TATE-SUPPORT that treats the Z-clause as refuted by base-corner non-Tateness is invalid. The universally quantified base and universal-curve conjunct should be dropped or replaced by a named-atlas hypothesis; even on a named atlas, FND-0167 controls only Z^{S_6} via (H-S) and the [6] and [5,1] multiplicity spaces via (H-C), not the remaining S_6-isotypics.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads: ATT-0118 is a disproof of the universally quantified j=8 instance of FND-0167 hypothesis (H-S) on an allowed etale atlas component V of Hbar^bal. Its claims CLM-0118-1 through CLM-0118-5 never mention Z=Ord(U), A, or Delta. REV-0165 confirms that disproof and, in strongest_attack, explicitly records that Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) is untouched, that FND-0167's corner map runs the wrong way to propagate non-Tateness from the base, and that over a 15-dimensional S the Abel-Jacobi bundle A has dimension 17 while Delta has dimension 16, so F^15 H_c^16(Delta) need not vanish. FND-0171 is that residual obstruction, not a restatement of the (H-S) disproof. Packet FND-0167 (corroborated) independently states the injection Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q)^{S_6}=Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U;Q) into Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) direct-sum Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S;Q)(-1) direct-sum Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S;Q)(-2), and explicitly makes no assertion about the truth of (H-S). Non-transport of non-Tateness is the one-way consequence of that injection together with exactness of Gr^W and semisimplicity of polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of fixed weight (Deligne, Theorie de Hodge II, Theoreme 2.3.5; Hodge numbers vanish for p greater than the dimension, recorded in the same paper's introduction). FND-0165 independently gives only the corner injection Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U)->Gr^W_16 H_c^16(A), never a lift of classes from A to U. Dimension counts: FND-0162 gives that Hbar^bal is smooth of pure dimension 15, so an etale scheme atlas S has dimension 15; A is a P^2-bundle, so dim A=17; FND-0134, FND-0155 and FND-0161 supply fibrewise density of U in |L| isomorphic to P^2 and a nonempty discriminant curve (dual curve, and in type (ii) the dual cubic of degree six union ten lines), hence dim Delta=16. The bound F^15 H_c^16=0 therefore requires dimension at most 14 and fails at Delta; already dim Delta>=15 would block it. Compactly supported cohomology of algebraic varieties carries a functorial mixed Hodge structure (Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III), so the localization and projective-bundle maps are morphisms of MHS. Discriminant loci of spanned linear systems are proper closed in |V| by Bertini and, for a non-linear curve image in P^2, of dimension 1 (Lanteri-Munoz, arXiv math/0701870). No contradiction with CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001: the finding does not assert that the Z-corner is non-Tate or Tate, and C66-TATE-SUPPORT is excluded from resolving RED-0001. Distinct from FND-0167 (conditional Tate reduction, not a non-transport obstruction) and from the sibling atlas-dependence candidate (falsity of universal (H-S), not the Z-clause). Merge target none.
